name: copilot-completions
description: Code completion powered by LLM — GHOST (FIM Inline Completion) and NES (Next Edit Suggestion)

commands.title: Toggle Inline Suggestions for Current Language

cc-completion.enable.description: Enable inline completions by language ID. Individual languages override the * fallback.

cc-completion.exclude.description: Glob patterns for files where inline completion and next edit suggestions are disabled.

cc-completion.ignoreWhenSuggestVisible.description: Temporarily hide AI inline suggestions while the regular IntelliSense suggestion list is visible.

cc-completion.respectSelectedCompletionI.description: Build ghost completions from the selected IntelliSense item while its list is open. Defaults to on only when editor quick suggestions are disabled.

cc-completion.ghost.speculativePrefetch.description: Prefetch the next ghost-text completion after typing to reduce visible latency.

cc-completion.nes.speculativePrefetch.description: Prefetch the next edit after accepting a NES suggestion to reduce visible latency.

cc-completion.wordPatterns.description: Per-language wordPattern additions (appended to the built-in pattern, not replacing it). Only languages with an explicit key (or the "*" fallback) are affected; other languages keep their native wordPattern. Keys are language IDs; "*" is a fallback for languages without an explicit key. Values are regex fragments, optionally wrapped as /fragment/flags (non-g flags like i/m/u are applied; the stateful g flag is stripped).

cc-completion.ghost.endpoint.description: LLM API endpoint for GHOST. 'completions' uses /completions with an inline FIM prompt template; 'fim/completions' uses /fim/completions with separate prompt and suffix.

cc-completion.ghost.contextPlacement.description: Where GHOST sends diagnostics, recent edits and related code. 'prefix' lets standard completion servers see this context; use 'extra' for a server that supports Copilot's extra.context field.

cc-completion.ghost.stops.description: Custom stop sequences for GHOST generation. Empty uses Copilot's language-specific defaults.

cc-completion.ghost.promptTemplate.description: FIM prompt template. Use {prefix} and {suffix} placeholders.

cc-completion.ghost.capabilities.limits..description: Maximum output tokens for GHOST requests
Optional minimum interval (ms) between GHOST network requests; 0 uses Copilot-style request timing

cc-completion.ghost.presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty for GHOST completions (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

cc-completion.ghost.frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty for GHOST completions (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

cc-completion.ghost.stream.description: Enable SSE streaming for GHOST completions

cc-completion.nes.stream.description: Use SSE streaming for NES edits. Disable this for endpoints that only return a complete response.

cc-completion.nes.family.description: Model family for NES thinking mode

cc-completion.nes.capabilities.limits.ma.description: Max output tokens for NES (hard cap)

cc-completion.nes.promptTemplate.description: NES prompt template. Use {system} and {user} placeholders.

cc-completion.nes.allowWhitespaceOnlyCha.description: Allow NES to suggest interior whitespace and line-wrapping changes. Leading or trailing whitespace-only changes are still ignored.

cc-completion.nes.allowImportChanges.description: Allow NES to suggest import statement edits. Disable to filter edits that add, remove, or change imports.

cc-completion.nes.suffixOverlapThreshold.description: NES duplicate-line trimming: 1 uses exact line matches like native Copilot; lower values opt into fuzzy suffix matching

cc-completion.nes.suffixOverlapType.description: Fuzzy NES suffix overlap detection type when the threshold is below 1

cc-completion.nes.presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty for NES (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far.

cc-completion.nes.frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty for NES (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency.

cc-completion.nes.nextCursorPrediction.j.description: Show a standalone cursor jump when prediction finds a location but the next-edit model finds no edit. Off matches Copilot's default next-cursor behavior.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
